description: Hand-derived golden values for the FlawCheck deterministic UT engine (Phase 8). Every expected value was computed by hand from the case's derivation string, reproducible with a calculator — never generated by running the implementation. The Zenodo source dataset ships inputs only (no ground truth for any output), so this fixture set is the ground truth. Integrity: tests/fixtures/golden/MANIFEST.json pins the sha256 of the exact bytes of this file and the case count.

cases.derivation: P*D = 4.0*114.3 = 457.2. S*E*W + P*Y = 138*1*1 + 4.0*0.4 = 138 + 1.6 = 139.6. Denominator 2*139.6 = 279.2. Pressure term = 457.2/279.2 = 1.637535816618911... by long division (check: 279.2*1.6375358166189 = 457.2). tPressureB313 returns the RAW term with no rounding; the 6 dp canonical value 1.637536 is asserted via requiredThickness in case required-pressure-governs. Plus FCA 1.0 = 2.637535816619 mm. [Phase 8 spec-slip correction: the original derivation rounded mid-way to 1.637536 (6 dp), which this function does not do.]

P*D = 4.0*114.3 = 457.2. Denominator 2*S*E = 2*138*1 = 276. Pressure term = 457.2/276 = 1.656521739130435... by long division (check: 276*1.6565217391304 = 457.2). tPressureBarlow returns the RAW term with no rounding; the 6 dp canonical value 1.656522 is asserted via requiredThickness in case barlow-required-pressure-governs. Plus FCA 1.0 = 2.656521739130 mm. [Phase 8 spec-slip correction: the original derivation rounded mid-way to 1.656522 (6 dp), which this function does not do.]

Raw pressure term incl. FCA = 2.637535816619 (see b313-pressure-term); requiredThickness canonicalizes it to 6 dp: 2.637536. t_required = max(2.637536, 0) = 2.637536 — pressure governs (API 574 para. 10.5.1.4).
t_pressure = 2.637536 (6 dp canonical, see b313-pressure-term) < t_structural = 3.0, so t_required = max(2.637536, 3.0) = 3.0 — the structural minimum governs (API 574 para. 10.5.1.4).
Barlow t_pressure incl. FCA = 2.656522 (6 dp canonical of the raw 2.656521739130, see barlow-pressure-term). t_required = max(2.656522, 2.0) = 2.656522 — pressure governs.
19.849999 < 19.85, and reject is strictly less-than, so one micro-metre below t_required rejects.
19.85 is not < 19.85, so it falls to the guardband branch: 19.85 <= 19.85 + 0.1 — exact equality with t_required is re_check, never reject (locked boundary convention).
19.95 = 19.85 + 0.1 exactly; the upper guardband bound is inclusive, so equality with t_required + gauge_uncertainty stays re_check.

CR_LT = (12.0-11.5)/2.0 = 0.25, loss 0.5 mm > 0.1 deadband, valid. CR_ST = (11.75-11.5)/1.0 = 0.25, loss 0.25 mm > 0.1 deadband and interval 1.0 yr >= 0.25 yr minimum, valid. Governing effective = max(0.25, 0.25) = 0.25 mm/yr; no quarantine flags.

CR_ST = (11.9-11.5)/0.2 = 2.0 mm/yr, but the 0.2 yr interval is below the 0.25 yr minimum, so the short-term rate is quarantined. CR_LT = (12.0-11.5)/2.0 = 0.25 mm/yr, loss 0.5 mm > 0.1 deadband, valid. Governing effective falls back to the long-term 0.25 mm/yr; governingRaw keeps the audited 2.0.
t_actual = 19.85 <= t_required = 19.85 — the component has reached retirement thickness, so remaining life clamps to 0.0 yr, never negative.
